section.1: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah

1.name_native: The Book of Purification and its Sunnah

hadiths.text: Qais bin Talq Al-Hanafi narrated that his father said:"I heard the Messenger of Allah being asked about touching the penis. He said: 'That does not require ablution, because it is a part of you (your body)
